text: As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, ethical questions are more important than ever. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from their training data. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must be a key goal. Privacy is another issue, since AI often relies on collecting and analysing personal information. People also deserve transparency, meaning they should understand how AI makes decisions that affect them. Above all, responsible AI development means builders, companies and governments must work together to create systems that are safe, honest and fair for everyone.
